items.title: OpenAI was founded out of fear of Google
items.summary: Business: OpenAI launched as a nonprofit on December 11, 2015. Sam Altman's pitch to Elon Musk was that AI would be built anyway, so it shouldn't be Google that got there first. Backers committed a headline $1 billion to advancing digital intelligence 'unconstrained by a need to generate financial return.'

items.title: GLM 5.4 bets on looped transformers
items.summary: Models: ZAI says looped transformers, where reasoning happens inside the model weights rather than in output tokens, let a 750B-parameter model match a 2–3T-parameter one, claiming Kimi 3.1-level performance without ultra-large inference costs. items.title: The end of labs shipping models whenever they choose
items.summary: Policy: Anthropic gave its powerful Mythos model a private period under Project Glasswing, letting partners use it to harden systems before public release. After the public version launched in June, Amazon warned the government about a jailbreak. A June 12 directive ordered access cut for foreign nationals, and because Anthropic couldn't build identity checks in time, it pulled the model for everyone for 18 days.

items.title: The real significance: AI goes from private to public
items.summary: ◆ The Take: Anthropic priced on November 18 at $83, above its $70–78 range.
